item.title: Gill‐Inspired Biomimetic Engineering Enables 100 000‐Cycle Stable Potassium Storage of MXene
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a gill-inspired biomimetic strategy, chemically coupling 4-methylvaleric acid to MXene, simultaneously solving air instability, restacking, and structural collapse. The organic-inorganic interface creates a molecular pillar and dipole effect, enabling exceptional 100,000-cycle stability (92.1% retention) in aqueous supercapacitors—surpassing most state-of-the-art MXene electrodes and offering new design principles for durable energy storage.
🏷 MXene · potassium storage · biomimetic modification · interfacial dipole · supercapacitor cycling

💡 The novelty lies in a Ga–In–Sn liquid-metal-modified carbon cloth that self-activates in molten salt, spontaneously reconstructing and pre-aluminizing to form an aluminophilic interface. This lowers nucleation overpotential and guides uniform Al deposition, enabling anode-free Al batteries with ~1000 h stable cycling and over 80,000 cycles at high rate—advancing high-energy, low-cost storage.
